quest.title: Teucer's Terrific Tour
quest.description: The Snezhnayan boy that you met by chance while investigating the Ruin Guards turned out to be Childe's younger brother Teucer. Childe requests that you keep his "identity" a secret and that you give the boy a tour of Liyue.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: This price is fair. Well then, I'll get that custom order done for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, thanks, Granny!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Worry not, just leave it to me.

talks.objective: Take Teucer out to the toy store

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Eh? What are those super-colorful winged things?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're called kites. The kids in Liyue love them!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Hello there, dear! You look like you've come a very long way. Let granny guess — from what you're wearing, I would say... Snezhnaya?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, that's right. How do you play with these kite things, Granny?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: When the wind picks up, you let out the string, and whoosh! The kite will fly into the air, up, up and away!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Wow... That's amazing. Do you have any Mr. Cyclops ones?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Mr. Cyclops...? I'm sorry, I—

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: I wanna fly Mr. Cyclops high into the sky so all the kids can get to know him!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Well, I can do custom builds, but I'll need some amount of reference material...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Will this picture do? I drew it myself. I bring it with me everywhere!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'll manage. Still, I must warn you that custom builds can really be quite expensive...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, we should be fine, Childe was pretty generous with that entertainment fund...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... But then again, throwing money around willy-nilly is, y'know, kinda irresponsible...

choices.text: What do you really mean...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, um, so... Yes, technically speaking, these funds are earmarked for Teucer's entertainment... But, if there's any left over when we're done...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Either way... it's time to talk prices!

choices.text: You think we should pocket the change?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh-heh, your words not mine! But yes, we're on the same page here.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Huh! I for one would like to see what this dandy boy's made of...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Children, children, I do hope you're not trying to make a mockery of me.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: I'll stick to my price, and not a Mora less... If you seriously want this custom build, then I would hope you can be serious about the price.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, Granny! We didn't mean it like that... Alright, Granny, we'll go with your price.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: That's more like it. Not to worry, now. Just leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Found him! There's Childe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, he's talking to... the Treasure Hoarders?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: You know what I'm here for, I trust?

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Oh, you've got lip. Makin' us guess, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: If you wanna join up, let me just say this first — dandy kid like you? You ain't welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Oh ho. What a commendable imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Well, in the Tsaritsa's name, I suppose I should forgive you country bumpkins for your ignorance. For I am—

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Brother!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: You're selling them toys, aren't you, brother? That's so cool! I've always wanted to watch you work!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: ...Why, yes, of course! For I am, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: ...The greatest toy salesman in Snezhnaya!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: So cool!

dialogues.speaker: Slick Wu
dialogues.text: You playin' games, pretty boy?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: ...So, will you buy, or not? The toys that Snezhnaya produced three months ago will run you... yes, 600,000 Mora. To be paid in full.

dialogues.speaker: Sneaky Wu
dialogues.text: T—Toys? And h—how much money!?

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Wow, is that what it's gonna cost to fix that head of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Crowd
dialogues.text: Hahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Look at that! Spreading joy and laughter to everyone — that's what toy selling's all about!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I'll say it again. Toys from Snezhnaya, three months prior, 600,000 Mora, paid in full.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Yeah... No. Sorry, salesboy — the same joke isn't funny twice.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Or were you always cruisin' for a bruisin'?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright then, I'll make things a little easier for you. I'll join the Treasure Hoarders. Perhaps you'll be more willing to pay when we're brothers-in-arms?

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Huh! Would you listen to yourself!? You think we just let any old person into the Treasure Hoarders? I'm not so sure you could hack it...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: *chuckles* Well then, why don't you put me to the test, dear seniors? I like to think of myself as quite talented in the field of treasure hunting.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Hmph, looks like you're not gonna pack it up until someone packs you in. Alright then. Show us what you got.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Truth be told, we've set up shop here because there's a fine little loot cave nearby. But the treasure hasn't been easy to get at. We've been at it for two days now.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: If you think you're up to snuff, why don't you have a crack at it on our behalf? 'Course, that means that once you've got it, it's ours. Don't you try to sneak off with the prize, now...

dialogues.speaker: Sneaky Wu
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Come on. If we can't do it, do you really think this guy stands a chance?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: An initiation test, eh? Interesting. It's been a while since I've been assessed by someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: The loot's on the <color=#00E1FFFF>opposite cliff</color>. We're gonna hang back here and watch the show...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: No problem. Don't blink, though, or you might miss it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Teucer. So you did come here!

choices.text: Don't you ever run off like that again, young man!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Shh... Quiet, my brother's giving his speech!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: ...From this day forward, you will honor the oaths you have made to Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and you will stop at nothing to bring Snezhnaya victory.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: You shall sweep through this land like the icy winds of the furthest north, as strong as the hoar frost of Zapolyarny Palace. You will chill the very marrow in our enemies' bones!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Her Majesty expects of you loyalty, ruthlessness, and meticulousness...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: For the trials that we face are harsh, and our enemies are like...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: ...Ahem, like kites and rattle drums...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Who shall become redoubtable foes of Mr. Cyclops in the marketplaces of Liyue...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Uh-huh. Kites are really fun, too.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: This is, of course, an analogy. As they say, "the marketplace, too, is a battlefield."

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: So as your... sales manager here in Liyue, I demand that you obey my every order.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: A refusal shall be considered a betrayal, and the price for betrayal is to be dishonorably discharged from... Ahem, from the Liyue Institute of Toy Research.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Whoa, that's really strict... Won't people be really sad if they get fired from the Institute?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Eh... uh...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: (Seeking to please everyone pleases no one at all. Time to try something else...)

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Forget it. Perhaps a round of hands-on training will suit us better.

response.speaker: Fatui Recruit
response.text: Hands-on... training?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: After all... a strong body is the proof of one's capacity.

response.speaker: Fatui Recruit
response.text: Hey. Did... did he just say that we're doing hands-on training?

response.speaker: Fatui Recruit
response.text: A Harbinger wants to spar with us personally? Wh—What an honor!

response.speaker: Fatui Recruit
response.text: I can't believe it... are recruits like us really worthy?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Am I hearing a hint of objection to this idea?

response.speaker: Fatui Recruits
response.text: Not at all, sir!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: That's the spirit!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Now, come at me, you lot.

choices.text: Your brother would have been worried sick.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: *sigh* All this haggling and wrangling... At this rate, everyone's appetites will be ruined.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I won't argue with you any further. You can take my price, or you can take your order elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, we're sorry, Chef Mao. We didn't mean to make you mad. We'll pay what you asked — all this bargaining's made us hungry too.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Ha, now that's better! Go find a place to sit. Your food will be with you shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Blergh, it was a little... too sweet. Paimon feels a little sick...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: I thought it was just right! Almost exactly like how sister Tonia makes it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But this doesn't feel right, somehow... Didn't we bring Teucer here to try Liyue's specialties?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Meh, whatever. So, where do you wanna go next, Teucer?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>wharf</color>! I was so caught up looking for my brother when I first got here that I didn't get a good look around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good idea. The hustle and bustle at the wharf is a specialty of Liyue Harbor too.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Wow, this place is huge! And there's so many people!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Are the waves here always like this? Don't they ever freeze?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, given Liyue's climate, the area around the harbor's mouth probably never gets cold enough to freeze.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon is kinda the Traveler's exclusive personal tour guide, but... since this is a special occasion, Paimon can make an exception to help Teucer get to know the place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is Liyue's commercial hub, and it's been the biggest port in the seven nations ever since it was decided that Liyue would take on the world through trade.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Other than merchant vessels, many fishing boats and industrial transports dock here to replenish their, uh, fishery supplies and daily necessie— necessities, which, thanks to the... immense... throughput capacity of the wharf... Um...

choices.text: Paimon, Teucer won't understand a word you're saying...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Yeah, Paimon can't remember how the rest goes anyway...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, guess Paimon will just have to explain this Paimon-style! So, this harbor is like Teyvat's mouth, and it's the biggest mouth you've ever seen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All the nations float their boats over the sea into the mouth. The harbor goes om-nom-nom-nom-nom and has a taste of each boat and the cargo it has on board...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, Liyue Harbor rubs its big round belly in satisfaction, because it's all stuffed full of delicious Mora!

choices.text: That's how you explain throughput capacity?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Hey, what's that big metal hook over there? I wanna see!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Teucer, don't run off!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, after all that, he wasn't even listening!

choices.text: Yes, this is all very... Paimon-style...
How about a topic kids would be interested in...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: That metal hook is huge! And it gets bigger the closer we get!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is an anchor. Docked ships use it to hold themselves in position, to stop the wind and waves from blowing them away.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Hmm, an anchor... Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: But I think I might get it mixed up with Commodore Hook...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Commodore Hook? Is this another one of your weird toy names...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: My brother always sends me a really big toy for my birthday.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Commodore Hook, Blacksteel Jack, Iron Tony... We keep them all in our backyard.

choices.text: Are they as big as that anchor?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Yeah, and that's why I can't bring them with me all the time. It's a shame...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, using Fatui funds for personal gain. To think Snezhnaya would let their Harbingers do that, all for some giant toys...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But suddenly, it doesn't seem so strange that Teucer would treat a Ruin Guard as a giant toy...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: But my favorite has to be Mr. Cyclops. Even though I mostly came here to see my brother, the other big thing I wanted to do was play with Mr. Cyclops!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Ooh, are they selling fish over there? Let's have a look!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Quit! Running! Off!

choices.text: They're all made of metal?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Hmm, this price is a little too low...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Is this where they sell fish? Wow, the fish here in Liyue are so... small.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Hey! Whose fish are you calling small? Little kids shouldn't go around ruining others' business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's just a curious kid... No need to get worked up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That said... These fish are actually pretty big by Paimon's standards. Just how big are the ones you're used to, Teucer?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Um, maybe two hundred times your size?

choices.text: That's crazy big...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: There are legends in my hometown about it. It's supposed to be a super delicious fish.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: I told my brother about it, and he went out to sea to catch one for me.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: A few days later, he returned with a humongous fish slung over his shoulder. Anthon and I were so happy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you sure that was a fish? Paimon thinks it sounds more like some sort of... leviathan...

choices.text: Sounds like a topic that would interest Xiangling...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: #Hey, {M#Mr. Nice Guy}{F#Ms. Nice Lady}, let's go over there to see the boats!

choices.text: Your brother spoils you too much.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Hee-hee...

choices.text: Actually, that's still pretty small...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Two hundred of Paimon would squish you flat, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Hey now, come on. I can barely cover the cost of the ingredients at that price.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Teucer? Are you tired? You don't seem so happy.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: I miss my brother...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? But we were just with him!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Yeah, but for such a short time that it doesn't count!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Take me to see my brother! I don't want to play anymore!

choices.text: That's children for you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, you can have all the patience in the world, but it won't help you at a time like this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we've played with Teucer long enough, haven't we? Paimon thinks we've tried our best here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Childe said that he'd be by <color=#00E1FFFF>the river near Qingxu Pool</color>. Why don't we look for him there?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Yay! Let's go, let's go!

choices.text: Guess we've got no choice...

talks.objective: Bring Teucer to where Childe is

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Well then. Do you all understand what I said earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Recruits
dialogues.text: Yes, sir!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Excellent. And, you all almost managed to get me limbered up.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: In other words...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: You have done well — for new recruits.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Recruits
dialogues.text: Thank you, Lord Harbinger!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Alright, hush now.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Now, then. I wish you all glorious victory — for Snezhnaya, for Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and for yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Dismissed!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Brother! You were amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Oh, Teucer! What in the world are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: There I was thinking that the Traveler had taken you to play at Wangshu Inn, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes, that's some terrible acting.

choices.text: You really did get stronger.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Haha. I told you, didn't I? I never pass on an opportunity to improve my strength.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'm not the man I was when we first met.

choices.text: You didn't go all out, though.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: By that, I assume you mean that I didn't use the Foul Legacy Transformation, yes?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: It puts a great strain on my body, so it's best saved for crucial moments.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I still haven't fully recovered from the injuries I suffered when I used it at the Golden House.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Anyway, I'm no Signora — I don't use lethal force against recruits, come on now...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: The Foul Legacy Transformation? Does it make you stronger than Mr. Cyclops?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You could say that.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: I wanna learn to fight too. I wanna be cool like you!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Now, Teucer. Fighting isn't about looking cool. You can only continue to get stronger if you know the reason why you're fighting.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I can teach you. But think carefully, first. Why do you want to fight?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: I... I want to protect sister Tonia.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: That's a good answer, Teucer.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: When I return to Snezhnaya, I will start teaching you fighting techniques. Then, you'll have to protect Tonia for me. How does that sound?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Hehe... Leave it to me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, Teucer's a good kid when he's not being so stubborn.

choices.text: Agreed.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: You've had a nice long time here in Liyue, haven't you, Teucer? Isn't it about time that you took the boat back home?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: But, but... but you've been so busy, and we didn't get any time to play together yet...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #Teucer, you know I'm very busy at work... And hasn't it been fun traveling all over the place with {M#him}{F#her}, a proper traveler?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (He's just worried he won't be able to keep up the toy seller act forever...)

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: W—Well, how about this? If you just do one little thing for me, I'll be a good boy and go back home!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Oh dear, who taught this little devil to bargain... *chuckle* Alright. What'll it be?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Take me to visit the Institute of Toy Research!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Do you think he means that ruin that the Millelith was telling us about? The one where all those Ruin Guards were coming from?

choices.text: A reasonable wish.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Done deal. After all, you've come all this way for me, Teucer...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: As your brother, it's only right for me to grant you one last wish before you leave.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Exactly! Hee-hee.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, are you sure this is a good idea? It doesn't seem like the best place for kids...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: You should come along too, Traveler! This time, it's Teucer's turn to take you sightseeing!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Let me think... Yes, the Institute of Toy Research is not far at all from <color=#00E1FFFF>Lingju Pass</color>. Now, Traveler... you're not the sort of person who would disappoint a kid now, are you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ugh, the brothers are ganging up on us again... Fine! {NICKNAME} and Paimon will go.

choices.text: A risky wish.
Protecting family is an admirable motivation.
Didn't see your black armor anywhere.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Haha. You must mean my Foul Legacy Transformation.

choices.text: That was a good showing.

talks.objective: Complete the Treasure Hoarder's test by obtaining the treasure

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Ah, you folks... *sigh* Let's go with this, then. Any more haggling, and we'll ruin the other customers' appetites.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe. Thanks, Chef Mao!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Please sit wherever you like. Your food will be here shortly.

talks.objective: Talk to Slippery Wu and attempt to obtain the treasure again

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: The loot's on the <color=#00E1FFFF>opposite cliff</color>. We're gonna hang back here and watch the show...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: No problem. Don't blink, though, or you might miss it.

talks.objective: Talk to the member of the Treasure Hoarders

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Well, I have the goods. Here you go. So, how'd I do? Pretty well, I'd say.

dialogues.speaker: Slick Wu
dialogues.text: B—Brother... What do we do? This fellow isn't normal...

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Please... hold on a moment, sir. We need to discuss something amongst ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: He ain't here for an initiation. He just wanted to show off.

dialogues.speaker: Sneaky Wu
dialogues.text: Honestly, we'd be no match for him if he wanted a fight...

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Guys... do you think that maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: ...we're being robbed?

dialogues.speaker: Sneaky Wu
dialogues.text: I don't know... surely he wouldn't have come here all dressed up like that if he was only after us? Unless... Maybe his words have hidden meaning?

dialogues.speaker: Slick Wu
dialogues.text: Snezhnaya, three months, 600,000... Oh, I get it! It was insider talk!

dialogues.speaker: Slick Wu
dialogues.text: I remember that the boss took out a 600,000 Mora loan from that Snezhnayan bank about three months ago, and still hasn't repaid it.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: So this guy must be the debt collector... But why didn't he just say so? What's with all the toy talk?

dialogues.speaker: Slick Wu
dialogues.text: Haha, and that's where you're still green. See, in a lot of professions like this, people speak in code to protect the privacy of their business partners and clients.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Makes sense... Owing money is pretty embarrassing.

dialogues.speaker: Sneaky Wu
dialogues.text: This guy isn't one to mess with, I tell you. He's a professional. Way too professional.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: So, Mister... Salesman. My apologies, but we can't have you joining us.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Oh? I didn't pass? I must say, I never imagined that the Treasure Hoarders would have such strict entry requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: No, it's not that. What we mean is that you're too big a fish for our little pond.

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: But we fully understand the situation with the... uh, toys, sir — we'll fetch that 600,000 for you right away.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I see. Well then, it's been a pleasure doing business with you. We get paid, and everyone stays happy. A wonderful outcome, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Slippery Wu
dialogues.text: Yes, couldn't agree more, sir!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: That's my brother for you! Toy sellers are so cool!

choices.text: He's a bit of a special case...

response.speaker: Felix
response.text: Ah, Master Childe, you're here.

response.speaker: Felix
response.text: A new batch of fresh recruits have just...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hey now, keep your voice down. Can't you see I'm entertaining some clients over here?

response.speaker: Felix
response.text: Clients? ...Uh, well anyway, the motherland has dispatched a new batch of recruits to Liyue. They've just arrived, and I'm afraid we must trouble you to speak to them...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Ugh, do I have to? Now is hardly the best time...

response.speaker: Felix
response.text: I must apologize for troubling you, Master Childe, but they are already waiting for you <color=#00E1FFFF>south of Lingju Pass</color>...

response.speaker: Felix
response.text: Every new batch of recruits must be baptized by the Tsaritsa's will through the words of her Harbingers. This has always been our rule.

response.speaker: Felix
response.text: At present, Master Childe, you are the only Harbinger in Liyue. Please, everyone is standing in formation and waiting for you to bestow this honor upon them...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Well alright then, I'll go. Just give me a moment to catch up with my brother, and I'll be right with you.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Do you have to keep working?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Yes, Teucer. We have a group of new toy sellers fresh in from the motherland, and I need to go teach them the ropes.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Wow, that's great! When I grow up, I wanna be a toy seller too! Can I go listen?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #Hmm... I'm afraid you're still too young, Teucer. I'm not sure if you'd understand much of it, and most of it's rather boring, anyhow. Why don't you go play with the {M#Traveler guy}{F#Traveler lady} instead? Sound good?

choices.text: You're dumping him on us, again?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: But... But...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I really do have to go now, Teucer. A lot of people are waiting to see me.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'll see you around, alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Childe really dotes on his brother, but now he's gotta ditch him again. Must be a really tough job...

choices.text: I think that covering it up is the tough part.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you're right... He hasn't done himself any favors with the whole toy-seller cover story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To think he'd go this far just to prevent his family from seeing his... dark side.

choices.text: He's being a bit overprotective.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe, but he has good intentions, doesn't he?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... Where's Teucer?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Agh! We were too busy chatting! Where'd he go?

choices.text: I didn't notice...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did he sneak off to follow his brother?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Either way, let's head over there first!

choices.text: At a guess, he probably snuck off to follow his brother...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems likely! Teucer did seem really eager to hear his brother's speech...

choices.text: I wonder how much longer he can hide it from Teucer...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wonders too. But hey, let's at least help him out while we're all in Liyue...

choices.text: It'd be a lot less tough if he just came clean...
No.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Please. I'll compensate you...

choices.text: That went more smoothly than I thought...

talks.objective: Go to Childe's location to look for Teucer

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll be hanging out with Childe's kid brother for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Hello! Welcome! Table for three?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Whew, this restaurant has a really... choking smell...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: A "choking smell"? You must be referring to our signature spicy chili scent.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Spicy chili? But I... can't eat spicy food.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Ah, what a pity. A person who can't eat spicy food misses out on half of life's joys.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it really that bad?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: My meals have to have lots and lots of sugar, and the oil has to be extra virgin vegetable oil.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, we've got a real rich kid on our hands...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Wanmin Restaurant's dishes aren't to Teucer's tastes... Maybe we should go somewhere else...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: —Will that be all? Any more special requests?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What do you mean, Chef Mao?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Ha! Giving the people what they want is the very reason Wanmin Restaurant exists.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: If I thought for one second that I couldn't make a dish to satisfy this child's tastes, I would have absolutely no business calling myself a chef ever again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there seems to be a lot of professional pride riding on this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we'll leave it to you, Chef Mao. We will be eating here after all.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: But let me say this first: special requests are going to cost you more than normal.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Of course, we aren't going to demand prices anywhere near as exorbitant as the likes of Liuli Pavilion or Xinyue Kiosk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or are premium custom orders in fashion lately?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still... Hehe... Surely there must be a little room for negotiation, right?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: So, so, so where are we going to play first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... how about we start with the <color=#00E1FFFF>toy store</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For our next stop... why don't we head to <color=#00E1FFFF>Wanmin Restaurant</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It would be a mighty crying shame to come all the way to Liyue and never try the food!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Fine, fine. I've neither the time nor energy to bargain with you at my age. I suppose this price will do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, thanks, Granny!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Worry not, just leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: No, that won't do... This amount won't even pay for the materials...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Done. I'll go prepare the food, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! It's time for a nice meal!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Please sit wherever you like. Your food will be with you shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: That seems a bit on the low side... You do realize these dishes will be prepared specially to your requirements, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Slick Wu
dialogues.text: As long as I'm watching, he's not getting away with the treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Sneaky Wu
dialogues.text: Seems mighty confident... Maybe he really does know a thing or two...
